authorNotes.markdown:
## 리얼아머
### 0.1.6 Change Log
#### Global
##### Added
* Added configurable item drops when hits reduce NPC armor durability, including gunshots.
* Added per-armor drop tables with independent chances and quantity ranges.
* Added per-armor controls for horizontal drop spread and upward speed.
* Added a standalone Armor Drop Editor with item selection and saved sets.
* Added Apply and Unapply controls for one active drop set per world.
* Added optional Armor Drop Editor access through compatible DRM builds.
* Added armor drops that preserve configured item names and custom item data.
##### Fixed
* Fixed configuration switches flashing and losing focus after clicks or server acknowledgements.
* Fixed stale configuration values and missed clicks after external settings reloads.
* Fixed duplicate toolbar hover text and excessive spacing between flyout buttons.
* Fixed percentage text formatting and dimmed item picker slots.
##### Changed
* Changed saved drop sets to activate only after explicit Apply confirmation.
* Changed standalone settings to use embedded DRM-style categories and controls.
##### Improved
* Improved drop table readability with separate item, chance, and quantity columns.
* Improved popup input handling and localized confirmation button layouts.
* Improved protection against conflicting edits, insufficient permissions, and failed saves.
